title: Key interrupted by an escaped newline in a string literal
summary: The two characters backslash and n sit inside the key in a JSON-style string.
rationale: Whether a consumer reads the escape as a line feed, keeps the two characters, or joins the fragments is not settled by this example.

expectation.rationale: Unresolved: the reading depends on the consuming language; no outcome is asserted.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
